workflowParity.bind_hint: Re-select voices after moving JSON. Translation uses the chosen phone model. Attach audio again; conversion accepts clips up to 30 seconds.
workflowParity.bind_voices: Choose a local voice for every speech or conversion step.
workflowParity.graph_hint: Connect each card to its next step. Both condition routes may rejoin. Every route must reach End.
workflowParity.incompatible_merge: These steps exchange incompatible text or audio. Rejoining routes must carry the same value type.
workflowParity.invalid_graph: Connect every step from one input to End. Conditions need one Yes and one No route; loops are not allowed.
workflowParity.invalid_language: Choose source and target languages for every translation step.
workflowParity.single_input: Use one script or one audio source per workflow. Split desktop batches before importing.
workflowParity.unsupported: This phone cannot execute the {{kind}} node. Remove or replace it on desktop before importing.
workflowParity.auto_voice_language: Saved phone voices detect language from the text. Select Auto for their speech language.
